articles.summary: Kratos reported its second quarter 2026 financial results, including Revenues of $458.8M, Operating Loss of $1.6M, Net Income of $4.4M, Adjusted EBITDA of $38.2M and a consolidated book to bill ratio of 1.1 to 1.0.
articles.title: Kratos Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results

articles.summary: Kratos has been awarded a contract by the U.S. Army DEVCOM C5ISR Center to develop an Enhanced Seeker for the Javelin Close Combat Missile System.
articles.title: Kratos Receives U.S. Army Contract to Develop a Next-Generation Seeker for the Javelin Missile System

articles.summary: Orbit Communication Systems Ltd. has received orders from multiple international customers for its GAIA 100 Tri-Band 5.5-meter and 6.1-meter antenna systems.
articles.title: Kratos Receives Multi-Million-Dollar Orders for GAIA 100 Tri-Band Ground Station Systems Through Newly Acquired Orbit

articles.summary: Kratos is allocating part of its expanded Spartan engine production capacity to support Boeing’s Joint Direct Attack Munition Long Range production program with TDI-J85 (J85) engines.
articles.title: Kratos Providing Spartan J85 Engines to Support Boeing JDAM LR Production Contract

articles.summary: GEK800 Engine Receives U.S. Military Type Designation F143-ZZ-100
articles.title: Kratos and GE Aerospace’s GEK800 Engine Receives U.S. Military Type Designation F143-ZZ-100 and EMD Contract Award for JASSM

articles.summary: Kratos supported the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) and Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force (JMSDF) during the Japan Flight Test Experiment (JFTX)-01, conducted March 17 and 19 off the East Coast of the U.S.
articles.title: Kratos Target Systems Utilized During Successful MDA-Joint Flight Test Experiment-01 Mission
